blocks.text: Perito Moreno Glacier: viewing walkways beside the blue ice wall

After breakfast, head to the national park on the Argentine side of Iguazú Falls. The park has been a UNESCO World Heritage Site since 1984.

The ecological train runs through dense rainforest to a network of walkways. The visit covers three classic routes: the Lower Circuit, the Upper Circuit and the Devil’s Throat.

**Lower Circuit.** The paths cover about 1,700 metres and descend to viewpoints below the cascades. From there, you can look up at the falls, including Salto Álvar Núñez, Salto Elenita and Salto Lanusse. At Salto Bossetti, one of the most striking cascades, the water drops in an almost unbroken curtain.

Allow about 1 hour and 45 minutes for the Lower Circuit. The walk is of moderate difficulty.

**Upper Circuit.** This route is about 1,300 metres long. The walkways pass over the rushing water, giving you a view of it flowing to the edge and plunging below. The Adam and Eve Falls are among the highlights.

Allow about 1 hour for this easy circuit. The ascent is step-free.

**Devil’s Throat.** Here, the water plunges 82 metres. You can hear the roar of the falls while you are still making your way through the rainforest. The ecological train and walkways lead to a viewpoint close to the cascade.

After the visit, transfer to the airport for your flight to Buenos Aires. You will be met on arrival and transferred to your hotel.
A rainbow above Iguazú Falls and viewing walkways with visitors
Iguazú Falls: a rainbow in the spray beside the walkways
Brazilian side of Iguazú Falls, Natal and Praia da Pipa

After breakfast, visit the Brazilian side of the falls.

You can hear the water as you approach. The name Iguazú is associated with the Guaraní expression for “big water.” The complex comprises 275 cascades. Trails and viewing platforms offer panoramic views of the falls.

The Devil’s Throat is one of the highlights. In places, the walkways come so close to the falls that the air is filled with spray.

After the visit, transfer to the airport for your flight to Natal. On arrival, your driver will meet you and take you to your hotel in Praia da Pipa.
